units.source_text: 汗水像蜡烛泪般地融化了。

en.t: The sweat melted like candle tears.
His pores were soaked with sweat.

units.source_text: 手表停了，不知道时间，说不定洞穴之外还是白天吧。

en.t: His watch had stopped, so he had no idea what time it was; perhaps outside the hole it was still daytime.

units.source_text: 可是，在这二十米深的洞底，已经是黄昏了。

en.t: But down at the bottom of this twenty-meter-deep hole, it was already dusk.
